routes.userPurpose: Identify the correct game and choose the next useful guide.
routes.aboveFoldAnswer: This fan-made wiki covers the Boiler Games experience where players plant, harvest, use a changing Bank deal, buy land and work with chickens.

routes.userPurpose: See the Farm an Island codes that last worked on Aug 7, their rewards, the Redeem path and a playable walkthrough.
routes.aboveFoldAnswer: THANKYOU last awarded 2 Free Seed Packs and ILOVEGEARS last awarded 3 Free Gears on Aug 7, 2026. Codes can expire, so try them in the current game.

routes.userPurpose: Complete the first-session loop and choose the next guide for crops, the Bank, land or chickens.
routes.aboveFoldAnswer: Plant seeds, harvest crops, check the timed Bank deal, transfer the batch and compare cash with the number on the next land pad.

routes.primaryKeyword: Farm an Island seeds and crops
routes.userPurpose: See the available crop details and watch the XL Durian example without leaving the guide.
routes.aboveFoldAnswer: The guide covers Carrot, Tomato, Potato, Bell Pepper and Durian. The XL section plays an example where fertilizer is used before a Durian card changes to XL Durian.

nextStep.label: See how the Bank fits the loop

routes.primaryKeyword: Farm an Island bank and money
routes.userPurpose: Use the Bank transfer correctly and understand why a timed Deal and a batch result do not equal fixed crop prices.
routes.aboveFoldAnswer: The Aug 5 footage shows an Average deal of 7 with 15 seconds left and a later batch result of 513; neither establishes a per-crop formula.

routes.userPurpose: Compare current cash with early land costs and decide when to expand.
routes.aboveFoldAnswer: Early land pads cost 65, 110, 100, 130, 170 and 220 cash when checked on Aug 5, 2026. Check the current pad before buying because the order may change.

routes.userPurpose: Understand the visible Common Chicken card and decide what is known before buying an XL-related pass.
routes.aboveFoldAnswer: The tutorial says a Chicken helps harvest crops and its card shows Common rarity and 2x Power; the multiplier formula and odds remain open.

routes.userPurpose: Know whether a dated official update record is available.
